subject: Meridian RFP: tenancy routing & audit exports (commitment ask)
messages:
From: Anita Rao <anita.rao@finguard.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-22T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Meridian RFP - routing/audit requirements

Connor / Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Meridian's execs were pleased with the latency profile and the evals. Procurement has one set of asks that need to be in the RFP response:

- Tenant-level residency (data partitioning) and routing rules so specific tenants can be pinned to dedicated capacity (we call this "tenant affinity").
- Continuous audit export (audit trail of inference requests + trace IDs) with daily and on-demand exports.
- Customer-managed KMS integration for key rotation and proof-of-possession.

These are gating items for our security review. Attached is our RFP summary and the procurement checklist. Can Redwood commit to timelines for a firm commercial proposal if you can support these?

Attachment: Meridian_RFP_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

Anita Rao
Head of Procurement, Meridian Financial
procurement@meridian.com

On behalf of FinGuard (Meridian Procurement)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-22T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Meridian RFP - routing/audit requirements (need prioritization)

Forwarding Meridian's procurement asks — this is a potential $3.2M ARR enterprise close (DEAL-4851). They want tenant affinity, audit export, and CMK. Procurement needs commitment on timelines to include in the SOW. High level asks:

- Can product/eng commit to a delivery option we can sign up to?
- If not, what are viable fallbacks (e.g., Private deployment + assisted onboarding, or hosted with daily export)?
- Rough ETA and required scope (engineering weeks + product work).

Why this matters: Meridian is asking to sign by EOY; procurement has flagged these three as gating. If we can give a reality-backed MAP we have a shot at immediate signature.

Please reply with recommended commitment (and the exact wording we can put in the SOW). I can take the response back to Meridian and include a MAP draft.

Attachments: Meridian_RFP_v1.pdf (re-sent)

—Connor
Sales Director, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-23T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Meridian RFP - routing/audit requirements (need prioritization)

Connor — thanks for the context and the RFP. High-level response and options below. I tried to keep the commitments concrete for SOW wording.

1) Tenant affinity / routing
- Current platform: we support per-tenant routing policies for model selection and region routing. We do not yet have a hardened "pin tenant to dedicated GPU pool with strict isolation" feature in hosted API.
- Commitment option A (Private path): Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) + guided deployment. We can commit to a configured tenant affinity shim and routing policy as part of a Private deployment SOW. ETA: 6–8 weeks of product+eng work to stabilize and document runbook (assumes dedicated capacity provided by customer or reserved Dedicated capacity).
- Commitment option B (Hosted fallback): Add policy-level soft-affinity for hosted with eviction/backfill rules plus SLA caveats. ETA: 4–6 weeks, but with a documented risk that bursts could fall back to shared capacity (we can include scheduled windows for guaranteed capacity).

Suggested SOW language (tentative): "Redwood will implement a tenant-affinity routing policy for Meridian that will allow designated tenants to be preferentially routed to reserved capacity. For customers selecting Redwood Private, Redwood will deliver a configuration and runbook within 8 weeks of SOW execution."

2) Audit export
- We can provide continuous audit logs with daily export and on-demand export in Private. For Hosted, we currently produce token-level telemetry and can add a structured daily export plus an ad-hoc export endpoint. ETA: 3 weeks for daily export pipeline; 6 weeks for on-demand export with queryable retention.

Suggested SOW language: "Redwood will enable structured audit export of inference requests (trace_id, timestamp, tenant_id, model_id, response_hash) with daily delivery to a secure storage location. On-demand exports will be available subject to Redwood support window and usage limits."

3) CMK/KMS
- We support customer-managed KMS for Private and Dedicated. For Hosted, CMK integration is available for enterprise customers through an integration path; it requires security review and 2–4 weeks to onboard per key provider.

Next steps I need from Sales: confirm whether Meridian will accept Private deployment in SOW or requires Hosted-only commitments. Also need a live call with Meridian security (Anita + security lead) to agree on export destinations and retention.

If we proceed with Private route, Ben and I will scope the implementation plan and provide a delivery timeline suitable for the SOW.

—Laura
Product Manager, Enterprise Features
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-24T15:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Meridian RFP - routing/audit requirements (engineering estimate)

Laura / Connor — engineering take and trade-offs. Quoting key lines from Laura above for clarity:

> "Option A (Private): tenant-affinity shim and routing policy — ETA 6–8 weeks."

Feasibility notes and estimate:
- Tenant affinity shim: ~6 weeks (2 engineers, full-time) to implement routing knobs, KV cache tagging by tenant, and isolation tests. Requires one additional week for documentation and runbook.
- Audit export (structured daily): ~2 weeks (1 engineer) to wire our telemetry into a daily export job with S3/HTTPS sink. On-demand export endpoint (query tool) is another ~3–4 weeks with added operational cost.
- CMK: if Private deployment, CMK is straightforward (config + docs). For Hosted CMK, we need an integration window (2–4 weeks) and a security review — can't promise a hard date until keys are exchanged and review complete.

Risks:
- Pulling work forward displaces two planned roadmap items (multi-tenant telemetry improvements and quantization compatibility testing). We can do this if Sales signs for delivery runway and we treat as an urgent priority.
- On-demand exports will add load to our telemetry infra; we should include rate limits in the SOW.

Minimal viable commit we can sign into SOW (engineering-approved):
- Private deployment: tenant-affinity configuration delivered within 6 weeks of SOW start; daily audit export delivered within 2 weeks. CMK support available as configuration work with a 2-week onboarding window.

If Sales needs Hosted-only hard commitments, we need a 4–6 week development sprint + an explicit carveout in the SLA for eviction/fallback.

I can produce a short technical appendix for the SOW that describes the exact behaviors, error modes, and runbook items.

—Ben Carter
Engineering Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@finguard.com>, FinGuard Procurement <procurement@finguard.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-25T17:48:00-08:00
Subject: Meridian RFP - proposed MAP and SOW language

Anita — thank you, and appreciate the quick turnaround from our product and eng teams. Below is a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and the commitments Redwood can include in an SOW if Meridian signs the Private deployment path.

Proposed MAP (high level):
- Week 0 (SOW sign): Redwood kicks off Private deployment; exchange initial infra details and CMK provider info.
- Week 1–2: Configure tenant-affinity routing shim and deliver daily audit export to Meridian's designated S3 bucket.
- Week 3–6: Stabilization, runbook delivery, and on-demand export endpoint gating (if requested, schedule + scope).

SOW excerpt (to include):
- "Redwood will configure tenant-affinity routing for Meridian within 6 weeks of SOW kick-off as part of Redwood Private, and will deliver a daily structured audit export to Meridian's secure storage. CMK onboarding will be executed during the onboarding window as listed in the SOW appendix."

Deliverables attached: Meridian_MAP_draft.xlsx (MAP with milestones) and SOW_stub.docx (SOW excerpt + technical appendix). Please review and let me know whether Meridian will accept Redwood Private, or require Hosted-only language. If Hosted-only, we will provide alternative SOW language but must include an eviction/fallback caveat.

Decision requested by: 2027-11-30 (to meet Meridian procurement window).

Thanks — I can schedule a 30-min security sync with Laura and Ben for early next week if that helps.

—Connor
Sales Director, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
